identityVerification.freshChecks: Live PR head/base and commit tree/sole parent; all 15 changed Git blob mappings including publication manifest; six product delta paths; source receipt hash and exact archived-copy equality.

findings.title: Reset failed package operations before retrying
findings.serviceFinding: A transient initialization/manifest failure leaves completed failed package.Operation cached. Later acquisition returns that failure without calling sdk.Initialize/sdk.Manifest again despite retryable diagnostics.
findings.requestedCorrection: Clear/restart the failed phase so a subsequent retry performs real SDK work.

findings.title: Emit the required invalid-set diagnostic reason
findings.serviceFinding: Null, malformed or latest release-set IDs receive SafeDetail status=failed instead of the frozen section 6.1 requirement reason=invalid-release-set; current tests miss this contract violation.
findings.requestedCorrection: Map the invalid-release-set diagnostic to its required canonical bounded reason.

disposition.routing: Return both independent findings to central; engineering dispatches a smaller corrective packet to the original author. Testing does not dispatch or implement the fix.
disposition.requiredFollowup: Fix only the bounded findings and relevant regression coverage under engineering's packet; obtain affected validation and a new-head GitHub review before closing this gate.
disposition.evidenceMeaning: Findings are attributed to the independent service, not reproduced or supplemented by a duplicate local code review.
